meta.title: Synthetic Biophilia - Image Gallery
meta.description: Explore the visual documentation of phyllotactic patterns and lattice structures

images.title: Lattice Study #01 - Side View
images.caption: Phyllotactic lattice structure exploring 169° golden angle rotation. This side view demonstrates the emergent spiral patterns that arise from simple geometric rules applied iteratively.

images.title: Lattice Study #02 - Top View
images.caption: Top-down perspective of the same 169° lattice structure, revealing radial symmetry and self-organizing patterns characteristic of phyllotaxis in nature.

images.title: Bush-Like Leaf Formation
images.caption: Organic clustering pattern generated through iterative spiral growth algorithms. The overlapping forms mimic the dense foliage arrangement found in natural shrubs.

images.title: Lattice Detail - Close-Up
images.caption: Macro view showing individual lattice cells and their geometric relationships. The precision of mathematical generation contrasts with organic emergent behavior.

images.title: Void Space Analysis
images.caption: Study of negative space within the lattice structure. Understanding void distribution is crucial for structural optimization in bio-inspired design.

images.title: Fern Spiral Configuration
images.caption: Fibonacci spiral pattern generating fern-like frond structures. Demonstrates the connection between mathematical sequences and organic growth patterns.

images.title: Heptagonal Tessellation
images.caption: Seven-sided polygonal arrangement exploring non-standard tessellation patterns. Challenges conventional hexagonal packing while maintaining structural integrity.

images.title: Density Variation Study
images.caption: Experimental variation in lattice density across the structure. Tests the relationship between packing efficiency and visual complexity.

images.title: Multi-Angle Composite
images.caption: Composite view showing multiple perspectives of the same structure. Reveals how three-dimensional complexity manifests differently from various viewpoints.

images.title: Node Connection Mapping
images.caption: Visualization of connectivity between lattice nodes. Graph theory applied to spatial relationships in bio-inspired structures.

images.title: Pentagonal Void Formation
images.caption: Five-sided negative space emerging naturally from the generative algorithm. Demonstrates how simple rules create complex geometric diversity.

images.title: Recursive Branching Pattern
images.caption: Self-similar branching structure generated through recursive subdivision. Mimics the fractal nature of tree branch systems and venation patterns.
